I replied to Tobias in your DM (DHARNES0001). I told them I'll keep the possible contact change at Quarrendon Freight Lines to myself. It won't go into any channel, any other member's DMs or any drafts. Until it's confirmed, I'll treat the current contact as the contact of record. I also asked them to tell me if it gets confirmed and where it's okay to share.

I didn't write it to gbrain or anywhere else. The brain will still save this DM automatically, the same as every DM, but it only shows a DM to the member who sent it.
